name: Monk Fruit (Luo Han Guo)

low.description: About 2 teaspoons powdered or equivalent liquid

siboNotes: Monk fruit is FODMAP-free and generally well-tolerated in SIBO, though some commercial blends may contain fillers like erythritol that could cause symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels as commercial monk fruit may be blended with other sweeteners
Pure monk fruit extract is 150-300x sweeter than sugar, so use sparingly
Works well in both hot and cold beverages and baking applications
May have a slight aftertaste that some find fruity or licorice-like
nutritionalHighlights: Does not affect blood sugar levels
